BL-1547 — The send-time task-scope gate refuses a task-tagged commit touching a docs/how-to, specs/features or backlog file whose basename names a ticket already CLOSED on origin/main, so the only subject that passes drops the sender's own id - and the land step then credits the commit to the closed ticket and drops the path (BL-1537's 5dbd34f27f); a file named for a closed ticket is not foreign scope
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: a changed path whose basename names a ticket whose YAML is filed under backlog/done/ on the freshest of main/origin-main (BL-891 - compared, never trusted) is not a foreign-scop…
BL-1547 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1547" (or "reject BL-1547 <reason>") to act.
